# Part IV: The Safety Case {.unnumbered}

You have a machine. This part assembles what would justify operating it: who may intervene while it runs, what happens when it is broken on purpose, the argument that connects the evidence to a verdict, and an honest account of what that argument cannot settle.

A case is an argument someone can attack, never a guarantee. Nothing here claims a machine is safe. What it teaches is the reasoning that has to happen before anyone is entitled to say so.
